## Checklist

- [ ] Links an `accepted` issue (or is a tiny fix that doesn't need one)
- [ ] One concern, and small enough to review (~400 changed lines or less)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `scripts/test_core.sh`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] No new Chromium patches, or the PR explains why new code or a `chromium_src/` override can't do it
- [ ] No new Mojo interfaces, WebUI bindings or permissions, or they're called out above for security review
- [ ] I've read and understood every line, including any AI-generated code
